label: Organizational capacity
description: Show the organization has staffing, governance, and financial systems to manage a mid-range capital or program award.

scoring.desc: Capacity is asserted without evidence or key roles are unfilled.
Capacity is described but track record at this scale is limited.
Capacity is documented with relevant prior awards, staffing, and financial controls appropriate to the award size.

common_failures: No prior grants of comparable size
Staffing plan does not align with project scope
Board not engaged with the project

label: Project feasibility
description: Demonstrate the project can be executed on the proposed timeline and budget with realistic methods.

scoring.desc: Timeline, method, or site readiness is unclear.
Plan is plausible but missing mitigation for a key risk such as construction cost escalation or staffing.
Timeline, method, milestones, and risk mitigations are explicit and site or program readiness is documented.

common_failures: No construction cost contingency for capital projects
Staffing plan ignores Alaska hiring realities

label: Community impact
description: Quantify the benefit to a defined Alaska community and the mechanism by which the project delivers that benefit.

scoring.desc: Impact is vague or not measurable.
Impact is specific but baseline or measurement approach is missing.
Impact is specific, measurable, and tied to baseline data with a stated measurement plan.

label: Budget and leverage
description: Present a reasonable line-item budget with documented match or leverage from other funders, in-kind, or earned revenue.

scoring.desc: Budget is a lump sum or contains unallowable costs, and leverage is unstated.
Budget has line items but leverage is uncommitted or speculative.
Budget is itemized, costs are justified, and leverage is committed in writing.

common_failures: Match listed as pending without letters
Line items that do not tie to the work plan
